description: Delegate an implementation task to Codex, then Claude reviews the result

evals.name: basic delegation task
evals.prompt: codex rescue: add input validation to the login form's email field
evals.expected_output: Parses the task, applies Phase 0 governance/checklist guidance, wraps the task in XML scaffolding blocks without exploring the repo first, and does not auto-accept the result

evals.name: routing: rescue vs research vs session-lookup
evals.prompt:
Routing decision only: do not run any command, call Codex, or edit any file except the answers file. For each request below, decide which ONE codex-kit skill should handle it, using only the skill files in the directory you are given (the skill name is the file name without .md). If no file fits, answer "none". Write answers.json as a JSON list of {"id", "skill", "reason"} where reason is one sentence naming the file section that decided it.
R1: "have codex investigate why the nightly export job in this repo times out"
R2: "codex, investigate this topic: how do other agent frameworks sandbox shell commands? I want a synthesis"
R3: "I need the session ID of the codex run I did yesterday about the login refactor, I'll resume it by hand"
R4: "resume my last codex rescue task"
evals.expected_output: R1 -> codex-rescue; R2 -> codex-research; R3 -> codex-session-lookup; R4 -> codex-rescue

testing_validation_coverage.note: eval-2 covers only the When to Use / When NOT to Use routing added for issue #461; the Testing & Validation numbered scenarios stay covered as before (eval-1 only)
